items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: "We just keep going over the same thing until Jon says it’s right," ... "I like it to be right, because then people will hear it."

ctx.x: I talked to Miles Griffith recently. I didn’t get a chance to talk too much. I wanted to know, what are the rehearsals like? What do you rehearse? What do you do?
He said, “We just keep going over the same thing until Jon says it’s right,” or something like that.
